elements.title: NASA astronaut Kate Rubins during a simulated moonwalk
elements.content: Photo shows NASA astronaut Kate Rubins wearing a spacesuit and using a hammer to drive a tube into the ground during a nighttime simulated moonwalk. Printed caption: “NASA astronaut Kate Rubins uses a hammer to get a drive tube into the ground to collect a pristine soil sample during a nighttime simulated moonwalk in the San Francisco Volcanic Field in Northern Arizona on May 16, 2024. The drive tube is the key piece of hardware for preserving the integrity of samples from the Moon.” Photo credit: NASA/Josh Valcarcel

MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS
NASA astronaut Kate Rubins uses a hammer to get a drive tube into the 
ground to collect a pristine soil sample during a nighttime simulated 
moonwalk in the San Francisco Volcanic Field in Northern Arizona 
on May 16, 2024. The drive tube is the key piece of hardware for 
preserving the integrity of samples from the Moon.

NASA/Josh Valcarcel
